fato_historico: 2015: A fire in a nightclub in the Romanian capital of Bucharest kills sixty-four people and leaves more than 147 injured.
energia_do_dia: Today, your Leo spirit may feel extra vibrant. Just as light brings life, remember that every spark carries both immense beauty and the need for gentle care. It is a good time to cherish your connections and prioritize safety within your social circles. Consider how your warmth can provide comfort to those who might be walking through shadows.
frase_do_dia: Your inner light is a beacon that can guide others toward lasting peace.
significado_numero: Represents the collective strength found in unity and shared human experience.
conselho: Nurture your inner fire and protect the precious bonds you share with others.
